##### Project general facts

Azizi Grand is a modern residential development located in the dynamic Dubai Sports City, designed to redefine urban living through a blend of contemporary architecture and sustainable design principles. The project comprises 431 spacious apartments, including studios, one- and two-bedroom layouts, all thoughtfully planned with open configurations and expansive end-to-end balconies. The architecture emphasizes clean lines, natural light, and functional elegance, creating a harmonious living environment that reflects the active and vibrant character of the community.

Residents are offered a range of lifestyle amenities that enhance both comfort and well-being. The development features landscaped outdoor areas, swimming pools, and fitness facilities, along with spaces designed for relaxation and social interaction. The overall environment is carefully curated to balance leisure and activity, supporting a well-rounded lifestyle within one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential destinations.

Interiors are designed with attention to detail, incorporating modern finishes and a cohesive color palette that enhances the sense of space and light. Apartments feature spacious living areas with double-glazed windows and large balconies, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. Kitchens come in an open-plan format, fitted with durable countertops, quality appliances, and ample cabinetry. Units are offered unfurnished, providing residents with the flexibility to personalize their home according to their individual style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Sports City offers a well-balanced blend of lifestyle, wellness, and convenient connectivity. The district features international sporting facilities, green open spaces, and a vibrant atmosphere that appeals equally to families and professionals. It’s a place where everything is within easy reach — from active recreation to peaceful downtime.

Its strategic location provides direct access to major roads such as Hessa Street, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and Al Khail Road, making it easy to reach Dubai Marina, JVC, Motor City, and even Dubai International Airport within minutes.

Residents enjoy a wide range of infrastructure, including prestigious schools, medical centers, supermarkets, and shopping malls such as City Centre Me’aisem and Mall of the Emirates. Beaches, golf courses, and parks are all just a short drive away, while the canal promenade within Sports City itself offers the perfect setting for evening walks, jogs, or weekend gatherings with friends and family.
